rationale: Multiple public post-mortems and community threads document real dollar losses from undetected LLM API cost spikes, with the source post alone citing a $1,860 overage on a $620/month baseline — a 4x multiplier. Competitor products (LangSmith, Helicone, Portkey) exist and charge real money, confirming willingness-to-pay. The problem recurs monthly (invoice cycle is the detection lag) and affects any team shipping AI features without dedicated cost observability.
